sample_support: composite cultivated-grain-field topsoil, 0-15 cm, one 2020 winter sampling season
notes: This dataset is soil-property and spectral-metrology context, not a biochar treatment-effect dataset.

The Data in Brief article's data-availability row cites Zenodo record 17510653 (v1, 803 rows); Zenodo identifies record 21640671 (v2, 790 rows) as the newer version. Treat v1 and v2 as distinct artifacts. This profile pins v2; preserve v1 for historical comparison, not silent substitution.

The article is internally inconsistent about NIR value semantics: its specifications describe recorded NIR reflectance; its spectral-column section says all spectral values are absorbance but describes the NIR block as reflectance percentage; the acquisition method records reflectance R; the data-merging / figure text describes converted absorbance but does not state the exact conversion equation in the accessible text. Keep the semantics unresolved; never apply a second transform without inspecting source processing and the actual file.
Common axis is wavenumber cm-1, descending, with NIR 7407–4003 cm-1 and MIR 3997–600 cm-1; published NIR/MIR band gap is expected between 4003 and 3997 cm-1.
790 composite cultivated-grain-field topsoil samples represent 0–15 cm and one 2020 winter sampling season; they are not natural profiles or a longitudinal soil-health trial.

Reference chemistry: pH measured in 1:2.5 soil:1 M KCl; Bray-1 P with colorimetry; exchangeable K/Ca/Mg/Na via 1 M ammonium acetate at pH 7. Do not substitute pH(H2O), pH(CaCl2), total P, or unspecified cation methods.

NIR: handheld NeoSpectra FT-NIR, 1350–2500 nm, one 15-second scan per sample, white-reference scan before each sample batch. MIR: Bruker Alpha II DRIFT, 3997–600 cm-1, 2 cm-1 resolution, 30 co-added scans, gold-cap background checks.
Thirteen flat/blank MIR spectra were excluded before the published v2 cohort of 790 rows; this is distinct from the 21 sample-name mismatches reported for the earlier 2024 cohort.
178 samples have released WGS84 field coordinates. Do not infer coordinates for other samples from cooperative, town, or regional labels.
The 2026 cohort extends the 2024 Western Highveld MIR work; do not treat the 790 and 979 sample cohorts as independent until a reviewed identity crosswalk is completed.
The journal article is CC BY, but this alone does not establish the data file's redistribution licence. Confirm the versioned Zenodo data licence before mirroring or redistribution.
A publisher MD5 is recorded only as source metadata. Compute SHA-256 from the actual acquired CSV; no source SHA-256 is claimed until the file is retrieved and hashed.
